title: Ludion lesson (v0)
description: One taught unit of knowledge. Immutable. Lives at lessons/<subject>/<id>.json. If it is on main, it was verified.

subject.description: Directory name. A library, a tool, a field.

version.description: Version range the claim holds for, e.g. >=3.12

claim.description: One sentence, as the teacher wrote it.

code.description: Exits 0 iff the claim holds. Exit 0 with 'skip:' on stdout if the runner cannot test it.

quote.description: Exact span that appears on the page and supports the claim.

author.description: github:<login> of the signing account at signing time. For display; identity is author_id.

author_id.description: GitHub numeric user id of the account that signed. This is the teacher's identity. CI enforces it.

replaces.description: Lessons this one corrects. The old ones stay in history.
